title: D3.js
summary: Diagrams in the horror look: thin bone line-work and one rose accent on a dark, grainy 1000×1000 card, with typed labels, aged-paper notes and a failing lamp. Half are charts, half are the investigator's tools: timeline, evidence board, search map, recording, clock, calendar. All sample data is illustrative. Use them full-screen as cutaways, or pass "clear": true to float the card over footage on a soft dark panel.

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Thin horizontal strips on hairline tracks, one of them rose; values count up.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: One unsteady line drawn across a faint grid, with a point ringed in rose and labelled.

items.name: Two columns
items.description: Two figures as tall thin columns, bone against rose, with the gap stated underneath.

items.name: Ring percentage
items.description: One percentage as a thin ring filling in rose, the figure rolling up in the middle.

items.name: Night hours dial
items.description: Twenty-four hours round a dial as spokes; the small hours stand out in rose as a hand sweeps round.

items.name: Recording
items.description: A waveform played back under a playhead, with one burst of sound boxed and labelled in rose.

items.name: Timeline of a night
items.description: Times typed down a vertical line and what happened beside them, entry by entry; one in rose.

items.name: Evidence board
items.description: Typed notes on scraps of aged paper, pinned up and joined by red string pulled from note to note.

items.name: Search map
items.description: Faint roads and contours, a search radius spreading from the last known position, pins with typed labels.

items.name: Stopped clock
items.description: Hands run forward fast and stop dead on the time that matters; the second hand twitches without advancing.

items.name: Crossed-off calendar
items.description: A month of days crossed off in rough strokes up to the one ringed in rose.

items.name: Moon phases
items.description: The eight phases in a row, with that night's moon large above them and a cloud drifting across it.
